product_metadata.title: Burrito Tortilla Blanket Double Sided 47 inches for Kids, 280 GSM Cozy Flannel Fabric Novelty Giant Food Throw Blanket
features: 【A REALISTIC BIG BURRITO TORTILLA】Still feeling down for the boring life. Then try our comical burrito tortilla blanket! It’s not just a warm blanket, but a real giant burrito.The graphic design makes it look like a large burrito crust. When you wrap yourself in this burrito tortilla blanket, you become a human burrito! You can experience the warmth and softness of a real burrito in person.

【HIGH QUALITY FLANNEL FABRIC MATERIAL】Our tortilla blanket is made of premium flannel fabric. Double-sided printed flannel design brings you comfort and warmth.And the weight per square meter is reached 280 gram! So of course this tortilla blanket is soft, cozy and skin-friendly.

【CARE INSTRUCTION】Dyed with an environmentally friendly dye, our tortilla blankets are not easy to fade. Gently washing machine cycle or hand-washing with cold water is recommended, then you can dry this flannel blanket by air or with low temperature. Please avoid using bleach and irons, which can damage the structure of this flannel blanket.

【NEWFANGLED GADGET】Are you still worried about which gift to get him or her for the holidays. Then our novel fluffy flannel food blanket is a good choice to please them. Whether it's Christmas, Halloween or Thanksgiving, you can give this funny food blanket to your loved ones. And then they turn into a giant burrito, too. It must be a newfangled experience for them.

【MULTI-FUNCTIONAL WRAP BLANKET】This Flannel burrito tortilla blanket is made of lightweight fabric, it’s a burrito tortilla blankets for adults, kids even pets.And suitable for any season and any occasion where you want to feel fuzzy and gentle hug. You can use it on couch, bed, picnic, camping, trip or party. As long as our taco tortilla blanket is around you, the fun and comfort will always be with you.
